title: Speedboat
summary: Speedboats are a type of engine-powered watercraft used by the Huntik Foundation and the Organization for water-based missions. The Foundation's speedboats are brown with white stripes while the Organization's speedboats are grey with blue stripes.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dante Vale and his team used a small speedboat to travel across the Seine River in search of the Cave of the Gargoyle. However they were soon surrounded by Gar-Ghoul's powerful whirlpools, forcing them to jump to safety as Dante crashed the boat into the rocks, destroying it. [Into the River of Secrets]

In the Stavropolous River, the Huntik team used another speedboat of the same model as they searched for the Argo. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

Wilder and his team used two speedboats to travel to Avalon, following the Huntik team in their blue pontoon boat. [Knight of the Willblade]

Grier's Suits would their speedboats to transport supplies from the Greek coast to Sutos Island. One day, the Huntik accompanied them in the Huntik Foundation superyacht so that they could meet with Grier and ask him for help. [An Ally from the Organization]
